description: This class provides a default implementation of the ClusterConfig interface, encapsulating cluster configuration parameters such as the number of shards and a roles blocklist, initialized from a Typesafe Config object.

classes.name: DefaultClusterConfig
classes.description: Immutable class representing cluster configuration with methods to access configuration parameters.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method creating a DefaultClusterConfig instance from a Config object.

methods.name: getNumberOfShards
methods.description: Returns the number of shards for the cluster.

methods.name: getClusterStatusRolesBlocklist
methods.description: Returns the list of roles that are blocklisted in the cluster status.
